subject: E-Commerce
title: Personalization vs Manipulation
description: A 60-second lesson on Personalization vs Manipulation.

hook.text: Showing you running shoes because you bought running socks is helpful. Targeting you after a breakup is predatory.

buildup.text: Personalization uses data to show relevant products. Manipulation uses data to exploit emotional vulnerability.

discovery.text: Target predicted a teen was pregnant from her shopping patterns before her father knew. That crossed a line.

twist.text: Netflix recommends shows you'll like—that's personalization. A gambling site targeting recovering addicts is.

climax.text: The difference is intent: does the data serve the customer's interest, or exploit their weakness?

punchline.text: The goal is not certainty, but sharper thinking.

quiz.question: What distinguishes personalization from manipulation?
options: Whether the intent serves the customer or exploits their vulnerabilities
